name: Mezban
what: Restaurant staff run the whole floor from phones and tablets: waiters take orders, the kitchen screen gets tickets, the cashier bills with VAT and the owner reads the day's numbers.
hard_part: Orders keep working offline: every change is queued on the device with its own operation id and replayed exactly once when the connection returns, while live orders sync between devices over server-sent events. Payments, discounts and voids are deliberately online-only and need a manager PIN approval.
status: Live demo · production server deployed, no real restaurant yet
demo_note: one-tap demo roles (waiter, kitchen, cashier, owner); sample restaurant rebuilt nightly
facts: Demo seeded with 14 days of history through the real billing engine
VAT 15% and service charge with a Mushak 6.3 style tax invoice
